Closed JSON key/type/token checks and canonical parent containment reviewed. Found terminal dot/dotdot bypass of containment; repaired before PASS. Same PS twin repaired with raw leaf extraction because Split-Path normalizes dotdot.

Reviewed plugin selection, partial uninstall preservation, exact argv, path normalization, dangerous-root checks, files/agents/IDE cleanup. External unregister intentionally best effort and warnings; selected names fixed allowlist. JSON parse/read errors preserve original, write exclusive tempfile then rename. No general approval for arbitrary install-root: caller explicitly chooses root.

Reviewed dry-run, JSON parse/name ownership, array-only API result handling, argv and permission fallback. Manual fallback exit0 is explicit public contract and prints manual instructions, not proof protection applied. No live ruleset mutation performed for audit.

Reviewed digit-only version interpolation, existing-version lookup, changelog and loop tests before edits, managed-file list and stale-reference reporting. Contributor GNU sed utility, not claimed portable BSD sed. Actual release execution belongs separate explicit release task.
